get_club_members.description: List a club's members, grouped by how recently they were active (weekly, monthly, and all-time).
get_club_members.name: get_club_members

parameters.description: The club's URL ID, the slug at the end of its chess.com/club/ address (for example, san-francisco-mechanics-uscl). The full club URL works too, such as the url Get player clubs returns.
parameters.name: club_id

members.description: Each member appears in one list, by how recently they were active in the club.

get_club_profile.description: Retrieve a club's public details: name, member count, average rating, and admins.

club.description: For developers building on the Chess.com API.
club.name: Chess.com Developer Community

get_club_profile.name: get_club_profile

parameters.description: The club's URL ID, the slug at the end of its chess.com/club/ address (for example, san-francisco-mechanics-uscl). The full club URL works too, such as the url Get player clubs returns.
parameters.name: club_id

club.description: admin lists the admins' profile URLs; created and last_activity are Unix timestamps in seconds.

get_country_players.description: List the usernames of recently active Chess.com players who identify with a given country. Chess.com caps the list at 10,000, so it isn't a full roster.
get_country_players.name: get_country_players

parameters.description: The 2-letter country code (for example, US, GB, or IN), or a country URL such as a player profile's country. Chess.com also uses XE for England, XS for Scotland, XW for Wales, and XX for International.
parameters.name: iso_code

players.description: Usernames of up to 10,000 recently active players.

get_country_profile.description: Look up a country's Chess.com profile by ISO code.
get_country_profile.name: get_country_profile

parameters.description: The 2-letter country code (for example, US, GB, or IN), or a country URL such as a player profile's country. Chess.com also uses XE for England, XS for Scotland, XW for Wales, and XX for International.
parameters.name: iso_code

get_daily_puzzle.description: Fetch the current Daily Puzzle, or a random puzzle from the archive when Random is enabled.
get_daily_puzzle.name: get_daily_puzzle

parameters.description: Set to true to fetch a random puzzle instead of today's Daily Puzzle.
parameters.name: random

puzzle.description: publish_time is a Unix timestamp in seconds.

get_leaderboards.description: Retrieve the top-50 leaderboards across every category (daily, live rapid/blitz/bullet, tactics, and more).
get_leaderboards.name: get_leaderboards

leaderboards.description: Each board lists its top 50 players, best first.

get_player_clubs.description: List the Chess.com clubs a player belongs to.
get_player_clubs.name: get_player_clubs

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

clubs.description: The player's clubs. Each url can be passed as the Club URL ID of Get club profile or Get club members.

get_player_current_games.description: List the player's Daily (correspondence) games that are currently in progress.
get_player_current_games.name: get_player_current_games

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

games.description: Daily games in progress; empty when there are none.

items.description: white and black are the players' profile URLs; move_by is the deadline for the next move in Unix seconds, or 0 while the player to move is on vacation.

get_player_game_archives.description: Get the list of monthly archive URLs available for a player. Each URL points to that month's finished games.
get_player_game_archives.name: get_player_game_archives

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

archives.description: Monthly archive URLs, oldest first. Each ends in the year and month to pass to Get monthly games (.../games/2024/03).

get_player_monthly_games.description: Retrieve every finished game a player completed in a given month, including PGN, ratings, and results.
get_player_monthly_games.name: get_player_monthly_games

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: The 4-digit year of the archive (for example, 2024).
parameters.name: year

games.description: The month's finished games, oldest first; empty when the player didn't play that month.

items.description: white and black each hold the player's username, rating after the game and result (win, checkmated, resigned, timeout, agreed, and so on); end_time is in Unix seconds.

get_player_profile.description: Look up a Chess.com member's public profile: name, title, country, follower count, and account status.
get_player_profile.name: get_player_profile

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

profile.description: country is the URL of the player's country profile; joined and last_online are Unix timestamps in seconds.

get_player_stats.description: Retrieve a player's rating, best rating, and win/loss/draw record across each game type (rapid, blitz, bullet, daily, tactics, and puzzle rush).
get_player_stats.name: get_player_stats

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

stats.description: One entry per game type the player has played; a type they haven't played is absent.

chess960_daily.description: last.rating is the current rating and best.rating the highest reached; record counts the games won (win), lost (loss) and drawn (draw).

chess_blitz.description: last.rating is the current rating and best.rating the highest reached; record counts the games won (win), lost (loss) and drawn (draw).

chess_bullet.description: last.rating is the current rating and best.rating the highest reached; record counts the games won (win), lost (loss) and drawn (draw).

chess_daily.description: last.rating is the current rating and best.rating the highest reached; record counts the games won (win), lost (loss) and drawn (draw).

chess_rapid.description: last.rating is the current rating and best.rating the highest reached; record counts the games won (win), lost (loss) and drawn (draw).

get_player_tournaments.description: List the tournaments a player has joined, grouped into finished, in-progress, and registered.
get_player_tournaments.name: get_player_tournaments

parameters.description: The player's Chess.com username (for example, hikaru). A player URL works too, such as a leaderboard entry's url or a game's white or black player.
parameters.name: username

tournaments.description: Each entry's url can be passed as the Tournament URL ID of Get tournament.

registered.description: Tournaments the player has signed up for.

get_streamers.description: List Chess.com streamers along with their live status and streaming-platform links.
get_streamers.name: get_streamers

streamers.description: Chess.com streamers and whether each is live now.

get_titled_players.description: List the usernames of every player holding a given chess title (for example, GM or WIM).
get_titled_players.name: get_titled_players

parameters.description: The title abbreviation: GM, WGM, IM, WIM, FM, WFM, NM, WNM, CM, or WCM.
parameters.name: title

players.description: Usernames of every player who holds the title.

get_tournament.description: Retrieve a tournament's details, settings, standings, and rounds.
get_tournament.name: get_tournament

parameters.description: The tournament's URL ID, the slug at the end of its chess.com/tournament/ address. The full tournament URL works too, such as the url Get player tournaments returns.
parameters.name: tournament_id

tournament.description: settings holds the format (type, rules, time_class, time_control, total_rounds, and so on); start_time and finish_time are Unix timestamps in seconds.

description: Access public Chess.com data through the keyless PubAPI: player profiles and stats, games and PGN archives, clubs, tournaments, titled players, leaderboards, streamers, and the daily puzzle. No account or API key required.
